create_project.description: Create a new project in a specified Clockify workspace.
create_project.name: create_project

parameters.description: The workspace: pick one, or use its id from an earlier step such as List workspaces.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: The name for the new project.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Optional ID of the client to link this project to.
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.description: Whether everyone in the workspace can see this project. Set to false to make it private, visible only to admins and assigned members. Defaults to public.
parameters.name: is_public

client_id.description: ID of the client the project belongs to, if any.

client_name.description: Name of the client the project belongs to, if any.

id.description: Unique project identifier, taken by the time-entry actions.

create_time_entry.description: Log a time entry in a Clockify workspace with a specific start time, and an optional end time. Use this to record time you already worked.
create_time_entry.display_str_template: Create time entry for project '{1}' in workspace '{0}'.
create_time_entry.name: create_time_entry

parameters.description: The workspace: pick one, or use its id from an earlier step such as List workspaces.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: The ID of the project to log this time against. You can get this from the List Clockify projects action.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: Optional note describing the work done.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: When the time entry starts, for example 2026-01-28T09:00:00Z.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: When the time entry ends, for example 2026-01-28T10:30:00Z. If left blank, the entry is created as a running timer.
parameters.name: end

billable.description: Whether the entry counts as billable time.

description.description: The note describing what was worked on.

duration.description: How long the entry lasted, as an ISO 8601 duration such as PT1H30M. Null while the timer is still running.

end.description: When the entry ends, ISO 8601 UTC. Null while the timer is still running.

id.description: Unique identifier of the time entry.

project_id.description: ID of the project the time is logged against, if any.

start.description: When the entry starts, ISO 8601 UTC.

task_id.description: ID of the task within the project, if any.

delete_time_entry.description: Delete a Clockify time entry for good. This can't be undone.
delete_time_entry.name: delete_time_entry

parameters.description: The workspace: pick one, or use its id from an earlier step such as List workspaces.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: The time entry's id, from an earlier step such as List time entries or Create time entry.
parameters.name: time_entry_id

deleted.description: True once the entry is deleted.

time_entry_id.description: The id of the entry deleted.

list_projects.description: Retrieve projects in a specified Clockify workspace. Results are paged; raise the page size or step through pages to see them all.
list_projects.name: list_projects

parameters.description: The workspace: pick one, or use its id from an earlier step such as List workspaces.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: Set to true to show only archived projects, or false to show only active ones. Leave blank for active projects.
parameters.name: archived

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, starting at 1.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many projects to return per page, up to 5000. Defaults to 50, which is Clockify's own default.
parameters.name: page_size

count.description: Number of projects on this page.

has_more.description: True when this page came back full, meaning there may be another page. Clockify does not report a total, so this is the only signal that results were cut off.

client_id.description: ID of the client the project belongs to, if any.

client_name.description: Name of the client the project belongs to, if any.

id.description: Unique project identifier, taken by the time-entry actions.

list_time_entries.description: List your own time entries in a Clockify workspace, newest first, with each one's project and how long it lasted. Optionally only between two times or for one project.
list_time_entries.display_str_template: List your time entries in workspace '{0}'.
list_time_entries.name: list_time_entries

parameters.description: The workspace: pick one, or use its id from an earlier step such as List workspaces.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: Only entries that start at or after this time.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Only entries that start before this time.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Only entries logged to this project.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The most entries to return, up to 1000. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

has_more.description: True when the limit was reached, so there may be more entries.

billable.description: Whether the entry counts as billable time.

description.description: The note describing what was worked on.

duration.description: How long the entry lasted, as an ISO 8601 duration such as PT1H30M. Null while the timer is still running.

end.description: When the entry ends, ISO 8601 UTC. Null while the timer is still running.

id.description: Unique identifier of the time entry.

project_id.description: ID of the project the time is logged against, if any.

project_name.description: The project's name, if the entry has one.

start.description: When the entry starts, ISO 8601 UTC.

task_id.description: ID of the task within the project, if any.

task_name.description: The task's name, if the entry has one.

list_workspaces.description: List all Clockify workspaces your connected account can access.
list_workspaces.name: list_workspaces

id.description: Unique workspace identifier, taken by every other Clockify action.

description: Track time, projects, and workspaces in Clockify using a personal API key.

clockify_new_time_entry_trigger.description: Runs for each new Clockify time entry of yours in a workspace, a timer you start included, with its note, project, task and start, for one project or all of them. Entries already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.duration: How long it lasted, such as PT1H30M; empty while running.
output.end: When it ended (UTC); empty while the timer runs.
output.id: The time entry's Clockify id, for Update or Delete time entry.
output.project_id: The project's id, if it has one.
output.task_id: The task's id, if it has one.

parameters.description: The Clockify workspace to watch.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: Only watch time logged to this project. Leave empty to watch all your time in the workspace.
parameters.name: project_id
